verses.exactText: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
門徒問耶穌說：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
耶穌回答說：「也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出神的作為來。
趁著白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
我在世上的時候，是世上的光。」
耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
對他說：「你往西羅亞池子裡去洗。」（西羅亞翻出來就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回頭就看見了。

entries.content: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
門徒問耶穌說：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
耶穌回答說：「也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出神的作為來。
趁著白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
我在世上的時候，是世上的光。」
耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
對他說：「你往西羅亞池子裡去洗。」（西羅亞翻出來就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回頭就看見了。
耶穌經過時看見一個生來瞎眼的人。
門徒問這人生來瞎眼是誰犯了罪。
耶穌回答並說明趁著白日作工與世上之光。
耶穌和泥抹在那人的眼睛上。
耶穌吩咐那人往西羅亞池子去洗；那人前往池邊。
那人照吩咐去洗，回頭就看見了。

acceptanceInventory.category: One source artifact and one human review
acceptanceInventory.evidence: planning/evidence/scripture-source.json records the fixed provider, URL, commit, upstream hash, Public Domain metadata and exact story-local artifact hash; planning/evidence/owner-review.json transparently records the one remaining pending owner review.
Six ordered event rows bind runtime beats b01-b06 to John 9:1-7 verse keys and S1 ledger entries.
The canonical warrant and runtime enforce the unnamed observer's non-causal action limits.
Six canonical Beat contracts match runtime order, triggers, goals, sequences, dialogue and final states.
The actor-state matrix records entry and final state for every runtime actor on every beat.
No invented clue is required; all S2 staging is removable and explicitly non-causal.
Six non-punitive goals are bound to runtime evidence; the short flow has no recall card.
The canonical plan binds the tested courtyard-to-Siloam world, route, portal, collisions, camera and responsive targets.

acceptanceInventory.category: One final state on every path
acceptanceInventory.evidence: All six sequences have identical normal, skip, restart and re-entry parity hashes.
John 9:1-7 is bound to dialogue rows; the text-first UI intentionally does not require portraits.
Every dialogue row has a full-subtitle fallback; the personal-use candidate intentionally ships without unapproved TTS.
Completion requires b01-b06 and the immutable john9-story-complete contract ending at john9-b06-final.
The single repository-owner review covers disability and Jewish-group contextual wording by default; its pending status is recorded without claiming approval.

disabilityReview.rationale: John 9 directly depicts blindness, healing, identity questioning and social treatment; the single designated lightweight reviewer must confirm respectful wording, with specialist escalation only for a concrete dispute or public/commercial risk.

jewishGroupLanguageReview.rationale: The passage distinguishes Pharisees and other Jewish participants; the single designated lightweight reviewer must confirm contextual wording, with specialist escalation only for a concrete dispute or public/commercial risk.
